name: AD FS Hybrid Health Tampering
description: Hybrid Health watches AD FS, the on-premises sign-in service many companies still use for Microsoft 365. An attacker who registers a fake health server or deletes the real health service can hide bad sign-ins or spoof what the cloud thinks AD FS is doing. Employees still authenticate as usual; the monitoring story is what changes. Health-agent registration and deletion should be as tightly controlled as AD FS itself.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
